+      "Read(**/.audit/**)",
+      "Read(**/__pycache__/**)",
+      "Read(**/.mypy_cache/**)",
+      "Read(**/.pytest_cache/**)",

+            "command": "${PYTHON_BIN}",
+            "timeout": 10,
+            "statusMessage": "Enforcing plans locality on the target path",
